verdict.rationale: Logseq's documented Sync feature only syncs a single user's graphs across their own devices (Desktop/Android/iOS), not real-time multi-user collaborative editing with conflict resolution; no docs describe shared vaults or concurrent multi-collaborator editing. Community evidence further confirms sync is buggy, in beta/testing, and users resort to workarounds like Syncthing while being careful about running multiple instances simultaneously, indicating no reliable collaborative-editing capability exists.
